question: GnRH (ganodorelin) is a hypothalamic decapeptide that is secreted in a pulsatile manner. Lately a series of analogues have been developed that:

options.opa: All of them inhibit prolonged secretion of LH and FSH.
options.opb: All of them are GnRH receptor agonists.
options.opc: Goserelin and buserelin are antagonists of the GnRH receptor.
options.opd: The prolonged treatment gives rise to a typical symptomatology of an excess of gonadal steroids.
options.ope: GnRH agonists are contraindicated in prostate and breast cancer.
